name: Oct 2026 Innovation Sprint
shortDescription: Build next-gen student identity and credential infrastructure.
fullDescription: Comprehensive campus engineering hackathon to design secure automated solutions.

problemStatement.title: Automated Student Verification & Cryptographic Badging
problemStatement.content: Develop a modern, reliable system that generates secure participant credentials and integrates with event scanners.
problemStatement.objective: Eliminate duplicate badge forgery and automate fast verification at entry checkpoints.
problemStatement.requirements:
1. Fast sub-second alignment
2. Real-time exports
3. Cryptographic hash check
problemStatement.constraints: Client-side processing preferred to maintain attendee privacy.
problemStatement.expectedOutput: Deployable web app and verified GitHub repository.
